obfuscation_indicators: qualified entirely by these cautionary statements
risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively transparent and well quantified, including segment sales, margins, pension settlement effects, currency impacts, and 2023 guidance. Key risks include construction and demand weakness, supply-chain constraints, China/COVID-19 uncertainty, currency exposure, higher interest costs, and acquisition execution. The extensive forward-looking disclaimer and reliance on assumptions introduce moderate uncertainty despite an overall cautiously optimistic tone.
